subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 1re · Grammaire · Passif et discours indirect
description: Règles et automatismes — passif et discours indirect.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They have changed the law.
cards.back: The law has been changed.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They will announce the results tomorrow.
cards.back: The results will be announced tomorrow.

cards.front: Quand utilise-t-on by dans une phrase passive ?
cards.back: Quand l'agent est utile ou important : The novel was written by Orwell.

cards.front: Rapporte : She said, “I am tired.”
cards.back: She said (that) she was tired.

cards.front: Rapporte : He said, “I have finished.”
cards.back: He said (that) he had finished.

cards.front: Rapporte : He asked, “Where do you live?”
cards.back: He asked me where I lived.

cards.front: Rapporte : She asked, “Are you ready?”
cards.back: She asked me if/whether I was ready.

cards.front: Rapporte : He said, “Close the door.”
cards.back: He told me to close the door.

cards.front: Complète : She ___ me that she agreed.
cards.back: She told me that she agreed.

cards.front: Dans un récit au passé, que devient today ?
cards.back: that day

cards.front: Quelle consigne grammaticale conduit à cette réponse correcte : « The law has been changed. » ?
cards.back: Mets au passif : They have changed the law.
